```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  remove-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run decorator removal script
        run: |
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE" >&2
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          git diff --quiet || echo "changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit changes
        id: commit_changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          BRANCH=automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)
          git checkout -b $BRANCH
          git add .
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators"
          git push origin $BRANCH
          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install gh CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > /tmp/pr_body.txt
          This PR removes experimental decorators from the codebase.
          EOF
          gh pr create \
            --title "Remove experimental decorators" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --label automated \
            --head ${{ steps.commit_changes.outputs.branch }} \
            --base main
```
